name: gamem-wasm
description: WebAssembly port of Gamem math, geometry, and physics library

scripts.build:wasm: emcc cpp/src/MathGm.cpp cpp/src/GeometryGm.cpp cpp/src/PhysicsGm.cpp -I src/Web/cpp/include -O3 -s WASM=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS="['_malloc','_free']" -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS="['setValue','getValue']" -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -o dist/gamem_wasm.js
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:types

author: nicky_sus
